verses.t: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṁ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gacchanti …pe…. Na ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gantabbaṁ. Yo anādariyaṁ paṭicca ukkuṭikāya antaraghare gacchati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ādikammikassāti. Pañcamasikkhāpadaṁ niṭṭhitaṁ.
